# MOTOC Cloud Data Sanitizer v0.1.0-rc.5

## Release Status

This tag is a **Release Candidate** for evaluation purposes only.

It is not a production release, a fully signed release, or an enterprise release.

## Overview

MOTOC Cloud Data Sanitizer is a local-first desktop application for preparing
cloud billing data for FinOps analysis.

It supports:

- CSV/XLSX billing export preparation
- Sensitive identifier protection
- Local processing on the customer device

## Changes

- Public documentation alignment
- Release preparation updates
- Security documentation boundary improvements

**No functional changes.**

## Security

- No cloud connection during sanitization
- No automatic upload
- No credential collection
- Local processing only

## Verification

Release validation will verify:

- Platform artifacts
- Checksums
- Security metadata

This document does not claim that validation is complete or that a final release
has been published.
